<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

pij builds one first turn for a seat starting in a role: its type's definition and seed, the role's own text with parameters filled, the creator's focus or packet, and the role's memory index, each under its own heading with the line naming where it came from. `pij directory show <role> --first-turn` prints it and changes nothing.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A seat starts with one message that tells it what kind of seat it is, what its role is and what its role remembers.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Delivering it (plan 242 writes and delivers it at spawn).

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: `--first-turn` is in-process reads of the governance worktree: 0 launches, nothing written. No loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
